commits.author: ekaraosmanoglu
commits.message:
fix(deps): pin langchain4j.version to 1.19.0 to match quarkus-camel-bom

The Quarkus platform BOM pins dev.langchain4j:langchain4j-core to 1.19.0,
but this property drifted to 1.20.0. Since langchain4j-anthropic,
-mistral-ai, -pgvector, and -embeddings-all-minilm-l6-v2 aren't managed
by the Quarkus platform BOMs, this property alone pins them — the skew
caused NoClassDefFoundError on LANGCHAIN4JEMBEDDING projects and
malformed provider requests on LANGCHAIN4JAGENT ones at boot.

Springboot's langchain4j.version is kept equal to Quarkus's for
consistency, even though camel-spring-boot-bom doesn't pin
langchain4j-core itself.

commits.author: ekaraosmanoglu
commits.message:
chore(release): 4.1.0

Mechanical version bump, 4.0.1 -> 4.1.0, no functional changes.

Covers the reactor POMs (versions:set scope), the three out-of-reactor
pom-custom.xml files, pom_maven_central.xml, the UI (package.json /
package-lock.json; NavBar reads it via the Vite __APP_VERSION__
define), the Camel K modeline in MusicianRoute.java, the io.camelbee
coordinates in the dependencies.list files, and the <version> install
snippets plus the camel-k staging commands in the READMEs.

Verified with a full `mvn install` from repo root — the rebuilt UI
bundle embeds 4.1.0 and is correctly referenced from the core jars'
index.html.
